comment: Pin registry, 011-convention. It is a pin, not an attestation. Values recorded during the pilot phase; the preregistration freeze re-verifies every member and any change lands in DEVIATIONS.md. PILOT-PHASE CAVEATS the freeze must resolve: (1) the jpack binary is a local build from the v0.16.0 tag with the goreleaser ldflags, not the released checksums.txt artifact; (2) pilot harness scripts ran under CPython 3.8.20 (the machine default), not the 3.12 series used by studies 011/012.

forge.install: pip install -e <clone at pinned commit> into a CPython 3.11.13 venv
forge.note: Upstream scenario and fixture bytes are vendored under upstream/ with upstream/MANIFEST.sha256; upstream is never modified.

jpack.note: Local tag build (go1.26.5, CGO_ENABLED=0, goreleaser ldflags). Registered runs should pin the released binary verified against the release checksums.txt, per docs/building-with-packs.md replay discipline.

packs.note: Byte-pinned copies from judgment-pack-runtime v0.16.0 (evaluation corpus packs + two valid-document exception examples). jpack-project/packs/ must stay byte-identical; scenarios/mutations/packs/ must equal a fresh mutate_packs.py derivation.

cases.note: goldens/EXPECT-CHECK.json must record zero disagreements against the pinned evaluator
